issues.detail: The Vietnamese translation 'vì tôi đã hết lòng siêng năng' (because I have been diligent) misinterprets the Greek structure. The phrase 'αγαπητοι πασαν σπουδην ποιουμενος γραφειν υμιν' means 'Beloved, I am writing to you with all diligence' (present tense/continuous action). The Vietnamese 'vì' (because) implies a causal relationship that is not present in the Greek text.

The Greek phrase 'τη απαξ παραδοθειση' means 'the once delivered' (referring to the faith). The Vietnamese translation 'đã được truyền... một lần đủ rồi' adds 'đủ rồi' (enough/sufficient), which is not in the Greek text.
